descriptor: AI assistant that automates team tasks

voice.summary: Sounds like a productivity coach with a clean desk: short imperatives, simple words and a nudge to move faster. It promises time saved, never magic.
dos: Use short pairs like Work smarter. Move faster.
Keep nav and CTA labels to two words
donts: Do not promise to replace people
Do not use jargon like synergy

taglines: Sync with the tools you love
Automation that stays out of your way
boilerplate: Stellar.ai is a SaaS platform whose intelligent automation syncs with the tools teams already use to streamline tasks, boost output and save time every day.

microcopy.success: You're all set. Your tools are syncing.
microcopy.error: We couldn't connect that tool. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No tasks yet. Connect a tool to start.

logo.note: A chip mark nods to the AI brain behind the automation.
